description: SolarData is a dataset or data collection listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Datasets on Electricity Consumption and Generation", published or maintained by dazhiyang (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Download and manipulate some publicly available solar datasets. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The list files it under "Datasets on Electricity Consumption and Generation" (electricity consumption and generation). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity consumption and generation studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
